programme.desc: A coming of age tale told through the eyes of Tu, an ambitious young man from Auckland who will do whatever it takes to realise his dream of becoming a professional hip hop dancer.

programme.title: Suffragette
programme.desc: The story of the foot soldiers of the early feminist movement - women who were forced underground to pursue a dangerous game of cat and mouse with an increasingly brutal State.

programme.title: I Accidentally Wrote A Book
programme.desc: The inspiring story of 12-year-old Nina, who discovers the healing power of writing, and through it embarks on a journey of self discovery and enlightenment.

programme.title: The Return Of The Soldier
programme.desc: In 1916 England, as WWI rages abroad, a shell-shocked veteran returns home with no memory, forcing three women to confront the war's hidden scars and its impact on those left behind

programme.title: Casablanca
programme.desc: Rick Blaine, a nightclub owner in Vichy-controlled Casablanca, is forced to confront his past when Ilsa Lund enters his life, sparking a choice between love and heroism in the midst of WWII.

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: Alice Doesn't Live Here Anymore
programme.desc: At 32, Alice Hyatt (Burstyn) watches her dreams slipping away. Instead of a career as a singer, she has an abusive husband, an ill-mannered 12-year-old son and a life in small-town Oklahoma.

programme.title: The Departed
programme.desc: An undercover cop (DiCaprio) infiltrates a Boston gang as a mob mole (Damon) rises in the police. As identities unravel, both race to expose each other in Scorsese's gripping crime thriller.

programme.title: Shanghai
programme.desc: An American man (John Cusack) returns to a corrupt Japanese-occupied Shanghai and discovers his friend has been killed. While he unravels the mysteries of the death, he discovers a much larger secret.

programme.title: Baghdad Messi
programme.desc: In war-torn Iraq, a ten-year-old boy with a crippling injury has an unquenchable passion for football.

programme.title: Escape From Alcatraz
programme.desc: Fact-based story set in America's former maximum-security prison, from which escape was supposed to be impossible for habitual jailbreaker Frank Morris.

programme.title: Stars Of The Silver Screen
programme.desc: Thomas Cruise Mapother is an American actor and producer. He began acting in the early 80s and made his breakthrough with leading roles in the comedy film Risky Business (1983) and action drama film Top Gun (1986).

programme.title: 84 Charing Cross Road
programme.desc: Academy Award winners Anne Bancroft and Anthony Hopkins sparkle in this witty, touching drama about a transatlantic romance that begins at 84 Charing Cross Road.

programme.title: Gurrumul
programme.desc: Gurrumul is a portrait of an artist on the brink of global reverence, and the struggles he and those closest to him faced in balancing that which mattered most to him and keeping the show on the road.
